rule: Source commands retain original namespaces and text. Relocation can change module-owned generated/private names; source identity does not establish generated-name or olean byte identity.

groups.expected_change: Generated parser/elaborator/private auxiliary ownership follows the new module. Exact names require elaboration and full owned audit. The old owner must not retain a second registration.
Constructors, recursors, projections and deriving instances move with unchanged structures and public namespaces. Include generated auxiliaries in full owned audit.
Do not assert an inferred instance name from source alone. Record the actual declaration census and instance registration.
Any generated proof auxiliaries require full owned type/axiom audit. No new proof body was authored.
Exactly one original definition remains, with original namespace, definition text and noncomputable section context.

incompatible_mixture: Do not import either original preimage owner alongside the new core containing its moved declarations. Install the matching owner postimage.
